office_does: The county clerk is the administrative and financial officer of the Superior Court, keeping its records and handling its filings and money.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Scott Tinney (Prefers Republican Party), clerk since 2016, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Lewis County Clerk since 2016, after 23 years as a deputy clerk in Thurston County; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: County Clerk since 2016; deputy clerk in Thurston County 1993-2016 [S1]
Re-elected in 2022 with 57.3% over Linda Williams [S3]
Runs on experience: more than 33 years as a deputy clerk or clerk [S1]
